title: The guard refuses a git push joined by ';' after a check in the same command
why: A push chained with ';' runs even when the check before it fails, so a red check does not stop the push (#2098, 09:32 CST Nov 8).
note: Filed 09:51 CST Nov 8 from lane notes-fix-large-3 (session_013NEJL1rKuNDSwMxwArjXHb), its own mistake: `check_silent_undo ...; echo; git push` pushed though the check exited 1; fixed on #2098 with an empty Drops-lines commit. Fix: refuse, or ask, a `git push` joined by ';' after another command, and point to '&&'. Red case: that command. One home: extend the ';' reader of step git-write-after-failed-cd (ready), not a second parser. Doing  CST Nov 10: open PR #2144 on branch push-after-check-semicolon (triage live build).
